title: FDE Training
subtitle: Six weeks from how apps work to scoping a client's solution. Each week opens with a 1-hour kickoff; deliverables are due by Sunday of that week (weeks 1–2 are one block, due Sunday of week 2).

weeks.title: Programming fundamentals
weeks.focus: Frontend, backend, database and APIs; Postman, curl, GitHub and deploying

weeks.title: Voice AI basics
weeks.focus: How a voice agent works, LiveKit, and the RevRag agent settings

weeks.title: Telephony agent
weeks.focus: How LLMs work, using Claude Code well, MCP, tools and RAG, the campaign call lifecycle, SIP and telephony
weeks.build: P3: a post-call webhook from P2 to P1

weeks.title: In-app agent
weeks.focus: The RevRag SDK docs, common client issues, debugging with the RevRag MCP, A/B experiments
weeks.build: P4: a dummy app with the RevRag SDK

weeks.title: AWS, cloud and infosec
weeks.focus: Lambda, DynamoDB, S3 and CloudWatch, hooks.revrag.ai routing, infosec basics and client questions
weeks.build: P5: a Lambda that stores calls

weeks.title: Docs, infosec and scoping
weeks.focus: Platform docs and infosec with the product team; scoping and solution design with customer success
